description:
# 1.47.0-mod.1 (2026-10-22)

### Version naming

* Use <upstream-version>-mod.<revision>: this build is based on Hoodles 1.47.0.
* Rename the previous 1.49.0 distribution; patch code and features are unchanged.
* Use the source Update button once to migrate from the old numbering.

### Unified patch source

* Include all patches and resources from Hoodles Morphe Patches 1.47.0 in one bundle.
* Rebuild all Duolingo patches for 6.102.4, including the PR #1117 login and energy fingerprint fixes.
* Include Restore learning reminders and MicroG integration alongside Enable Premium.

Select your Duolingo patches from BeForU Morphe Patches only. Deselect the older Hoodles and local reminder copies for Duolingo to avoid applying duplicate patches. Update this repository source to receive future bundles.
